conventions.note: Gritty-pixel set: pixel-art-* profiles (nearest sampling, hard magenta key). Non-NxN grids (1x2, 2x3, 2x4) have non-square source cells: never lock them to a scale profile - hold consistency with maxBodyScaleCv 0.08 / maxAnchorYStd 0.05 plus an anchor guide. Exported sheets normalise to square cellSize frames regardless. Generation briefs live in art/briefs/<group>.md.

assetSchema.groupNote: Each `groups[]` entry's `group` name is both the directory under outputRoot and the registry row group. PreloadScene loads a row only when its group is in the arena slice's ART_GROUPS (integrator's edit). A missing asset inside a present group is a hard error.
assetSchema.id: Directory name under outputRoot/<group>/<id>/. Also the default texture/animation key.
assetSchema.baseAction: Optional, true on exactly one asset of a multi-action single-character group.
assetSchema.duration: Optional ms-per-frame override. 0 = sheet addressed by frame index, no animation.
assetSchema.icons: Optional string[] on an icon/prop sheet; index = frame number, each name adds ICON.<name>.

qcExceptions.reason: Full-bleed seamless floor tiles deliberately touch every canvas edge; strict background QC cannot pass by design (documented strict:false exception, same class as template arena/floor).
Tileable border bands touch the canvas edge on purpose; strict:false by design.
Full-bleed 9:16 backdrop; strict:false by design (template bg/arena precedent).

Zone skins ship as fully generated idle sheets (shoulder/crown silhouette swap per PRD §11); sweep/summon/enrage/death sheets are shared from the castle base — at boss render size skin identity reads from idle/crown, and 4x5 fully-skinned action sets would spend ~17 extra generations on frames visible <10s per run.

Palette meanDistance 44.48 (inside the profile's 48 cap, but over the zone brief's stricter 36): style.json's 18-colour list contains NO cold blue, so a correct Widow's Crown snowfield cannot score near 36. This REPLACES the previous tile, which scored 48.46 — actually over the cap — because it had been compromised toward the plum-grey palette until it read as grey slate rock rather than snow, which is the defect the pre-handoff critic flagged. Regenerated to hold the zone's cold-blue snow identity; the gate, not the tile, is what cannot be satisfied here.

art_review value-tier-absent:dark (0.4% dark against a planned 60%). This is the DESERT MIRROR RISK the zone brief names explicitly: the zone inverts figure/ground on purpose — a light bone field so the dark actors read as holes in the sand — so style.json's actor-authored 60/32/8 valuePlan cannot apply to this tile. Verified non-discriminating for floors: the same art_review call fails value-tier-absent:light on the castle and outlands floors, the two tiles the critic judged excellent, and reports silhouette distance 0.000 between all four because a full-bleed tile's occupancy is identically 1.0. Hard gates all pass: minAlpha 255, no black mass (0.01% under luma 60, all of it the style's own 1px bone-chip outlines), palette meanDistance 29.55, and actor figure/ground clash 0.63% against the old tile's 27.45%. Residual weakness kept knowingly: the violet trough mid tier reads thinner than the briefed one third (mid 5.6%).

Full-bleed seamless tiles touch every canvas edge by design; exported fullBleed without --strict (background-contamination waived by structure, same class as zone-*/floor-*). Value band set by the documented tonefit grade (art/briefs/v2-world/process-fullbleed.sh).
Full-bleed seamless road tiles, same class as floors-v2/floor-*.
Irregular fieldstones measure ~45-50px at 256 (PRD asks 32-40); a full 984-1000px crop to shrink them doubled the V-seam (16.5 vs noise 6.5), so the seamless 856px crop was kept.

Rectangular slabs: autocorrelation pitch 34-35px x 48-49px; the long axis sits 8px over the 32-40 band. Authored mean L* 19-22 (bright frost joints hold p99 at the L*36 ceiling); in band, lower third.

Provider returned a smoother, semi-photographic finish on most splats instead of chunky pixels; accepted because splats render at alpha 0.55 as soft ground variation under actors, graded into the floor value band by tonefit. Regenerate if they read as off-style in the run screenshot.

Derived, not generated: upper-half crops of the accepted base frames (art/briefs/v2-world/talltop.py) so the occluding top registers pixel-for-pixel with its base; a generated upper half cannot align.
Cells 0-1 (mudwall straight/corner) carry a small warm torch-glow blob at the top-left corner, the style's key-light specular; kept, reads as torchlit brick at 48-170px.

3x3 on a 1024 canvas gives 341px source cells, upscaled to the PRD's 512px cell with smooth sampling (nearest at 1.5x produced uneven pixel rows). Outlands/desert added unrequested wall torches (amber) beside several landmarks; kept as scenic light, they are not hazard telegraphs.

art_review silhouette-collision vs enemy-lanternmonk-move at 0.041 is a low-occupancy artefact of two small-in-cell subjects: measured bbox w/h 2.50 (flat leg-star, 73 px tall) vs 1.18 (upright hooded pear with hanging lantern, 98 px tall); visually unmistakable at 48-120 px.

art_review silhouette-collision vs canon enemy-paleknight-move at 0.041: both are upright bipeds, but the revenant is pale parchment (L* p75 71.3, trailing bandage strips) against the knight's cold dark steel (L* p75 40.8) - value, hue and trailing strips separate them; desert-only vs shared roster.

4-frame pendulum loop reuses the straight-hang drawing for frames 1 and 3 (generation of a distinct second straight pose failed provider-side); the original cadaver base frame was dropped because every edit re-rendered the wight as a skeletal hanged corpse, which is the identity all 3 gibbet sheets now share.
postureChange: lob raises crook and lantern overhead, body-scale cv 0.283 / profile drift 0.194 are the raised arm+lantern bbox, feet anchor std 0.003; scale profile bound and applied.
postureChange: revive rises from a sand mound to standing, so body-scale cv 0.107 is the pose; profile bound and applied, anchor std 0.008.

Death sheets are unbound from scaleProfile (collapse/heap poses; same build-wide rule as enemies-light/heavy deaths) and processed componentMode all + postureChange; bulwark/mirehag/gibbet deaths use a 1024 source cell because their heaps sprawl wider than the move cell.

Full-bleed 640x300 key-art crops of text-only 16:9 zone vistas; exported non-strict with fullBleed (threshold/edge 1, nothing to key) — background-contamination is waived by structure, same class as ui-icons/bg-menu. Text-over-art surface: zone-card name/stars need the §11 armour or a bottom scrim (desert and winter are light fields).

Export provenance: every sheet was generated by native generate_image (provider xai-oauth, anchors vision-1 + an accepted sibling sheet as explicit input) and exported by sprite-forge process-sprite.ts CLI --strict from the preserved raw, not by the OMP_SPRITE_EXPORT middleware. Reason: xai returns the key as hot pink (~rgb(251,51,184)) + JPEG fringe; the marker's pure-magenta key at 180 either deletes the violet glows or, with the chroma guard, keeps a pink halo (measured 60,300 protected px on icons-wpn-a). art/briefs/v2-icons/normalize-key.py maps the sampled bg to #FF00FF first (pixels only ever become key); rebuild.sh reproduces every export byte-for-byte from art/briefs/v2-icons/raw/.
